title: Verse of the day
subtitle: Bhagavad Gita · {{date}}

note.duty: Do today's work well and let the result take its own time.
note.anxiety: When the mind races today, come back to the task in front of you and one slow breath.
note.failure: If something doesn't go your way today, treat it as a step, not a verdict.
note.purpose: Ask today what is yours to do, and do that part fully.
note.anger: If anger rises today, pause before you speak. Calm is a strength.
note.relationships: Meet the people around you today without keeping score.
note.loss: Be gentle with what you're carrying today. What is true in you isn't lost.
note.gratitude: Notice one thing today that you're thankful for, and say it out loud.

slowPrefix: Things may feel slow for you right now.
